name: Choanephora Flower Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked spots on flowers Flowers quickly rot and collapse Soft rot on young fruits Cottony white fungal growth on infected tissues Black pin-like spores forming on rotting flowers Infected flowers stick to developing fruits and cause fruit rot
description: A fungal disease that attacks flowers and young fruits of many vegetables, especially cucurbits and legumes. It causes rapid flower rot and fruit decay under warm and humid conditions.
management: Remove and destroy infected flowers and fruits Improve plant spacing to increase airflow Avoid overhead irrigation Harvest regularly to remove infected tissues Practice crop rotation
prevention: Plant in well-ventilated fields Remove crop debris after harvest Avoid excess irrigation and prolonged leaf wetness Use healthy seeds and maintain field sanitation
